title: Shared Family Album Contribution Balance
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:photo contributor=*
| stats count as items by contributor
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how family album uploads split across contributor for shared album participation.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside shared album participation.
implementation: Capture each family album uploads event in `memory:photo` and normalize `contributor` so Splunk can compute the share by contributor.
visualization: Table of contributor with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how family album uploads are divided across contributor so you can tell if one part of shared album participation is taking over.
